theses.subject: Big Pharma

It passed the absolute-trend gate, which is the one validated drawdown-control leg in this market. Crowding (z=1.46) flags it as extended, so this is a cap-and-hold lean for staying power, not a chase.

theses.dissent: Crowded defensive sector that could unwind quickly on a risk-on rotation; healthcare is policy-sensitive.

falsifier.text: XLV underperforms SPY by 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date
